limitations: Source page inspected as published; documented aggregate JSON endpoint could not be retrieved in this environment. No private logs, raw terms or visitor IDs collected.
Publisher default summary uses retained log; chart dates 2026-10-12 through 2026-11-10 are not a guaranteed common window for every counter.

Raw tool counts exclude publisher self-tools and monitoring sessions; conduct classifier scans tool rows without the same exclusions. Displayed subtraction is not an independently verified disjoint classification.
Agent identity buckets are calculated before loop exclusion using daily visitor IDs, handshake session fallback and anonymous day fallback. MCP handshakes are a separate event counter.
Sector counts include repeated query-bearing search/tool events and are not deduplicated by buyer; public zero-result terms are not opt-in RFQs or confirmed lost demand.
Publisher-reported catalogue rows and traffic do not establish paying customers, actual costs, revenue, retention or independent supplier outcomes.
